comments.author: @jenniferjohnson-67
comments.text:
I spent six wonderful years living in Guam in the 1980s, and watching this video brought back so many memories. We lived in Talofofo and later Windward Hills, and during those years I had the chance to see almost every part of the island.
I was a teacher in two different villages, so we were often invited to village fiestas and community events. I still remember the people, the food, the small gatherings, and how welcoming everyone was. We were also there when the Pope visited Guam, and I was fortunate enough to be at the airport when the President and First Lady arrived. Those were unforgettable moments.
I even took flying lessons while living there, and I remember landing near military aircraft. We went through several typhoons too, which was certainly an experience I will never forget.
This video made me miss Guam, although I noticed that some of the Chamorro names and places were not pronounced quite the way I remember them. Guam has changed a lot since we lived there, but the memories of those six years are still very special to our family. I even earned two degrees from the University of Guam.
Thank you for bringing back so many memories of a place that once felt like home.
